objective: Prove or disprove the induced cycles half bound for all finite simple cubic graphs
new_proved_reduction: Consecutive degree-two triangles with distinct nonadjacent external neighbours
limitations: No proof or counterexample for arbitrary cubic graphs.
Triangle entries count indexed constructions, allowing isomorphic duplicates.
Completeness of cubic base representatives relies on geng.
Named graph and local-search results are lower-bound witnesses, not optima.
Auxiliary objective obstruction does not disprove the original conjecture.
